notes: The research names the defining parameter outright: **subtraction**. The 2002 signature single is "far more sparse in its percussive drum and woodblock arrangement than most popular hip-hop tracks at the time" — a hard kick, one dry clap/snare on 2&4, "a woodblock or tom carrying the only 16th activity, and no hat carpet at all". So the percussion block is inverted relative to every other entry in this batch: `percs` runs 2–4 hits a bar of woodblock, cowbell, timbale and tom at only −3 dB, while `hihat` is non-continuous at the 0.28 floor with velocities of 0.3–0.5 and an open hat at 0.02. The kit is loud where it plays (`velocityTiers` accents 108–127) and machine-tight (`quantizeStrength` 0.95). Melody is "unusual single timbres carrying the whole melodic burden" — 1–4 notes a bar, `contour.riff` 0.7, `halfStepDissonance` 0.18 for material described as "sinister and serpentine" — and the countermelody sits at the 0.3 floor because the research says it is essentially absent: one riff, one sub, one percussion figure. ⚠ Their producer is **The Neptunes**, who have their own entry; that board is cited, not restated here. ⛔ The `I` family at weight 2 carries the research's "major-key backing under minor-mode vocal melody", which the research itself marks `[LOW-CONF]` on the mechanism. ⚠ `bpm` 85–99 centre 91 is the research's band, and it marks the 189–192 catalogue readings as doubled readings of the same spine — the tempo band is algorithmic and `[LOW-CONF]`. ⚠ `confidence` is medium (research: high-medium): charts and credits are firm, the numbers are not. The **INFERRED** parameters are every drum density and the hat floor. ⚠ The bass ceiling came down from 42 to 39 so it stays under a chord part that starts at 40 — `coherence.rs` requires the highest bass note to sit at or below the lowest chord note, and this model overlapped by 3. ⚠ The bass pool was reopened after the coherence fix lowered its ceiling from 42 to 39 to keep it under the chords: that narrowing dropped it to 912/1000 distinct against a 950 floor. The range it lost at the top is given back at the bottom, where a bass belongs anyway, plus a fifth and some anticipation. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 944 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [1,2], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
